summary: Source-based supplementation of frameworks and voice: six reasoning omissions and four interaction/expression omissions restored with situated conditions; unchanged planning targets now met within ten percent; core and topic modules unchanged; no new behavioral tests.
reviewer: Codex builder; targeted source-based editorial review with explicit inherited review lineage, not independent scholarship or a recognition judge
limitations: This revision reviewed selected original passages across eight supplied cleaned transcriptions, not all eight bodies again; the earlier complete-body pass retains its declared exclusions.
Coauthorship, edited dialogue, translation, retrospective inference and overlapping episodes limit attribution and historical claims.
Source-supported census and formula compliance are editorial planning information, not empirical admission, completeness or fidelity measurements.
No new answer, control, judge, scenario or retry was run. Historical recognition results do not certify changed loaded inputs.
Long-term conversation, autonomous routing, post-compaction recall and distinctive recognizability remain unestablished.
